correctness.rationale: Passivity iff every lower energy shell population dominates every higher energy shell population follows by pairwise swaps and doubly stochastic rearrangement. In shell E, top occupations j range [max(0,E-n),floor(E/2)], giving negative log population cost aE+(b-a)j. Maximizing the two endpoint differences over all consecutive shells gives g_n=floor((n-1)/2) in either slope order. Exact equality gives no strictly positive extracted work; Gibbs a=b remains all-copy passive and ratios with zero a or b are included. The first violated integer g occurs at stated odd n, and the proof constructs the corresponding basis-vector swap. Independent exact integer extrema and full shell-population order were checked for n=1..12 and 1≤p2≤p1≤p0≤8 (1440 profile/copy cases); all matched the criterion, while the analytic integer maxima establish unbounded n.
